name: sim_sympy_capability
purpose: Tool-capability isolation probe for sympy -- unblocks symbolic load-bearing use.

pytorch.reason: not used: this isolates exact symbolic algebra, not tensor autograd or numeric density evolution

pyg.reason: not used: no graph neural message-passing surface is part of the symbolic matrix checks

z3.reason: not used: no satisfiability or bounded-real predicate is needed for this exact-algebra capability probe

cvc5.reason: not used: no SyGuS, SMT, or independent solver agreement is claimed in this packet

sympy.reason: capability under test -- eigenvals, simplify, solve, commutator

clifford.reason: not used: this packet checks explicit Pauli matrices in SymPy, not geometric-algebra basis construction

geomstats.reason: not used: no manifold metric, geodesic, or Lie-group geometry API is exercised

e3nn.reason: not used: no equivariant neural network representation or spherical harmonic API is involved

rustworkx.reason: not used: no graph construction, traversal, or graph invariant is part of this symbolic capability claim

xgi.reason: not used: no hypergraph incidence or higher-order network API is exercised

toponetx.reason: not used: no cell/simplicial complex topology API is part of this exact-algebra probe

gudhi.reason: not used: no persistence, simplex tree, or Betti-number computation is claimed

operation_sequence: construct exact SymPy symbols and small matrices
compute Pauli Z eigenvalue multiplicities with Matrix.eigenvals
simplify sin(x)^2 + cos(x)^2 to the exact identity value
run adjacent negative fixtures for non-identity, non-real roots, and noncommutation
run boundary fixtures for trivial solve, zero-matrix eigenvalues, and polynomial expansion
carrier_topology: finite exact symbolic expressions plus 2x2 and 3x3 matrices over SymPy integers and complex unit I; no geometric carrier or topology is claimed

observable.pauli_z_eigenvalues: exact eigenvalue key set from Matrix.eigenvals
observable.negative_and_boundary_sections: boolean pass fields plus exact stringified symbolic witnesses

pass_fail_predicate: positive_all_pass, negative_all_pass, and boundary_all_pass must all be true; each positive check must match its exact symbolic expected value; each negative fixture must avoid the false identity; each boundary fixture must return the documented SymPy form
graveyards: sin(x)^2 - cos(x)^2 treated as identity -- must not simplify to 1
y^2 + 1 treated as real-rooted -- roots must be detected as non-real
sigma_x and sigma_z treated as commuting -- commutator must be non-zero
alternative_formulations: numpy numeric eigenvalue and commutator spot-checks as classical numeric baseline only
z3 or cvc5 bounded encodings for finite polynomial identities in later tool-tool packets
manual matrix multiplication over Python complex numbers for the Pauli commutator fixture
out_of_scope: no bridge, axis, engine, or scientific coupling claim
demotion_condition: Demote to blocked tool capability if sympy is unavailable, any symbolic check fails, or strict receipt lint fails.
promotion_condition: May only support later sympy tool-lego or tool-tool packets after those packets provide their own admitted receipts.
next_lego_target: Use as a prerequisite receipt for bounded sympy symbolic micro packets.
blocked_until: No broader claim until a downstream packet cites this receipt and passes its own stage gate.
